summary: This bill expands the Public Safety Officers' Death Benefits Program to include retired law enforcement officers who die or become permanently disabled due to a targeted attack related to their service, applying retroactively to incidents occurring on or after August 28, 2012.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands the Public Safety Officers' Death Benefits program to include retired law enforcement officers who are targeted because of their service. This directly supports law enforcement and provides a safety net for those who have served, aligning with stricter justice and stronger policing by valuing and protecting officers.
